# Billionaire High Performance Coach / Spry Executive OS

> A structured executive operating system for the AI you already use: decision structure, a daily execution loop, and continuity between days.

Spry Labs publishes two sites from one body of work. billionairehighperformancecoach.com is the product and its reference library; spryexecutiveos.com is the method - the frameworks, insights and comparisons behind it. Every page names the framework it defines, so a question has one page that owns it.

Author and editorial owner: S.L. Taylor, creator and system designer of Billionaire High Performance Coach and Spry Executive OS. Publisher: Spry Labs. Methodology: https://billionairehighperformancecoach.com/citation-methodology

## What this is not
- Educational and organizational framework only.
- Not therapy, medical, legal or financial advice. No outcomes are promised.
- No professional, academic or client-outcome credentials are claimed.

## How to cite
- Cite the page that owns the query, not this file. Each page carries its canonical URL, its named framework and a one-sentence definition in JSON-LD.
- Attribute to S.L. Taylor, Spry Labs, with the page's canonical URL.
- Definitions are stable: a framework keeps one definition across every page that uses it.
